newsitem.title: INDIA: India cement sector tops in 95/96 profit - RBI study.
newsitem.headline: India cement sector tops in 95/96 profit - RBI study.

text.p: India's cement industry achieved the highest growth rate of 73.1 percent in post-tax profits, a study of 1,335 companies for 1995/96 (April-March) showed, the Reserve Bank of India said on Tuesday.
Paper and paper products followed, with a 58.4 percent growth in profit and electricity generation and supply third with 57.7 percent, RBI said in a summary of its study.
"The effective tax rate (tax provision to pre-tax profits) and interest burden were higher during the year 1995/96 compared to those in the previous year," it said.
Trading companies recorded the highest growth in sales (36.9 percent) as well as expenditure (36.3 percent), it said.

"Though companies belonging to tea, cotton, blended textiles and silk and rayon textiles (sectors) showed impressive increases in sales income, their expenditure increased at a higher pace, resulting in lower gross profits and post-tax profits," it said.

The RBI study surveyed unaudited financial results of firms in tea, sugar, textiles, silk, engineering, chemicals, cement, rubber, paper, construction, electricity, trading and diversified businesses.
